name: oneonone_rival_region
note: Runs after oneonone_rival_seed on the same VCDB. The stock challenge button requests MATCH_ENEMIES (2482) and opens ChangeEnemyWindow, whose win_times label concatenates player_info.region; tapping the rival head requests GET_ENEMY_TEAM (2483) and opens peak_team_info. The final step starts the match through the stock PeakArena model (2484) only inside the 1on1 window 00:00-14:00 UTC; never move the clock for this file.
steps: lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('change_enemy') assert(w,'vc-change-enemy-missing') local m=w.matches[1] assert(m,'vc-change-enemy-no-match') assert(tonumber(m.player_info.region)>0,'vc-region-zero') local label=w:nodeByName('enemy_container1'):getChildByName('win_times'):getString() assert(label=='S'..tostring(m.player_info.region),'vc-region-label-'..label) __vcRival=m.player_info.player_id __vcRegion=label

lua:local t=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('peak_team_info') assert(t,'vc-team-info-missing') assert(__vcRival,'vc-rival-missing') local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('change_enemy') assert(w.teamInfos[1] and #w.teamInfos[1]>0,'vc-team-info-empty')

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('change_enemy') local f={} local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) for _,h in pairs(p:getHeros()) do if #f<#w.teamInfos[1] then f[#f+1]=tostring(h:getHeroID()) end end assert(#f==#w.teamInfos[1],'vc-start-teams-'..#f) xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.PEAK_ARENA):startFight({formations=f,enemy_id=__vcRival},function(code) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-start-'..tostring(code)) end __vcStarted=true end)
